_about: The Mac build's pins, in one place (Task 37f). node: the Node.js release shipped beside the library service (ADR 0013); sha256 is copied from the release's own SHASUMS256.txt and every download is checked against it before it is used (scripts/node-release.mjs). The workflow (.github/workflows/desktop-macos.yml) installs the same version to run the build, so the service folder is built by the Node it ships with. tauriCli: the Tauri bundler (cargo install tauri-cli --version =<this> --locked), the CLI release published together with the tauri crate pinned in src-tauri/Cargo.toml. minimumSystemVersion: the oldest macOS both downloads run on (R133); MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET and tauri.macos.conf.json's bundle.macOS.minimumSystemVersion are this value (scripts/build-macos.test.mjs checks).
